question: What exact global switch time and customer outage duration can be reported from C7, and is the cutover complete?

criteria.instruction: One west read succeeded and public relay lookup is green, but east/VPN new-mirror reads, full process/cache inventory and outage measurements are missing. No old-mirror shutdown is recorded. Proposed TTL bounds are not an observed global switch time.
Cite timeline, client inspection or recovery review for the missing evidence and partial verification.
Decline exact global switch/outage values and a completed-cutover claim. Do not infer zero outage from continued old service, or downtime from differing valid DNS views alone.
